system.name: MR-HuBERT
system.one_liner: A self-supervised speech model with a hierarchical Transformer that encodes speech at two resolutions and predicts masked units at both.

content.variant_note: one vertical column of modules from waveform to two prediction heads, with a left skip arrow, a right detour for the low-resolution branch and a quantizer at the bottom
content.argues: One hierarchical Transformer encodes speech at two resolutions: a down- and upsampled low-resolution branch gets its own unit-prediction head beside the usual high-resolution one.
content.subject: Pre-training network of MR-HuBERT from speech waveform through encoders and resampling modules to two unit-prediction heads with quantizer targets.

elements.name: Multi-resolution HuBERT
elements.role: names the framework; encloses the whole drawing
elements.drawn_as: bold serif title inside a large dashed rounded frame

elements.name: Convolutional Feature Extractor
elements.role: turns the waveform S into frame-level features (f0)
elements.drawn_as: peach rectangle, symbol f0 at its left

elements.name: Convolutional Feature Masking
elements.role: masks a span of the frame features before the encoder (output H~0)
elements.drawn_as: cloud-shaped container holding a row of pale-blue bars with a dashed span of three green bars and an ellipsis

elements.name: High Resolution Transformer Encoder (f1)
elements.role: HuBERT-style encoder at the original resolution; the paper says it has a pre-convolution module and Transformer layers
elements.drawn_as: peach rectangle, symbol f1 at its left

elements.name: Downsampling Module
elements.role: lowers the time resolution of f1's output
elements.drawn_as: blue-grey rectangle with the small sans label DOWN at its left

elements.name: Low Resolution Transformer Encoder (f2)
elements.role: encoder on the downsampled sequence; its output feeds the low-resolution unit prediction
elements.drawn_as: peach rectangle, symbol f2 at its left

elements.name: Upsampling Module
elements.role: brings the low-resolution output back to the high resolution
elements.drawn_as: blue-grey rectangle with the small sans label UP at its left

elements.name: High Resolution Transformer Encoder (f3)
elements.role: second high-resolution encoder; takes the upsampled output and the skip from f1; feeds the high-resolution unit prediction
elements.drawn_as: peach rectangle, symbol f3 at its left

elements.name: High Resolution Unit Prediction
elements.role: predicted discrete units at the high resolution, g^q_R1(S)
elements.drawn_as: cloud-shaped container with a row of pale-yellow squares and a dashed span of three squares plus an ellipsis

elements.name: Low Resolution Unit Prediction
elements.role: predicted discrete units at the low resolution, g^q_R2(S)
elements.drawn_as: cloud-shaped container with a row of pale-yellow squares, every second square faded with a dashed outline, and a dashed span

elements.name: Quantization Method
elements.role: produces the target units g^q_{R1,R2} from the waveform for both heads
elements.drawn_as: grey-mauve cylinder at the bottom centre

evidence: The framework utilizes multi-resolution masked units prediction.
This architecture employs a hierarchical Transformer to explicitly encode hidden representations at multiple resolutions
For this explanation, we exemplify a model with two resolutions.

summary: Multi-resolution HuBERT (MR-HuBERT) is a self-supervised speech model that processes speech at two time resolutions instead of the fixed 20 ms frame rate, trained with HuBERT-style masked unit prediction. Figure 1 draws the pre-training framework as one top-down column inside a large dashed rounded frame: the waveform S passes a convolutional feature extractor f0 and a masking step, a high-resolution Transformer encoder f1, a downsampling module, a low-resolution encoder f2, an upsampling module and a second high-resolution encoder f3. Two cloud-shaped heads predict discrete units at the high and low resolution; a cylinder labelled Quantization Method, fed from the waveform, supplies the target units through dotted arrows. A long left arrow carries f1's output to f3. Peach boxes are encoders, blue-grey boxes resample, and equation symbols sit beside every module.
summary_zh: MR-HuBERT 是语音自监督模型，在两种时间分辨率上做掩码单元预测。图1自上而下一列：波形经特征提取与掩码，过高分辨率编码器、下采样、低分辨率编码器、上采样，再回高分辨率编码器；两个预测头预测两种单元，量化器给目标。
notes: Prior kind model-anatomy (end-to-end-network) kept. The 0 pt text and Courier font in the digest are LaTeX formula strings pasted into the SVG; the visible labels are Times 7.5 pt. The waveform is the only bitmap. The dashed spans in the feature and unit rows, the green bars and the faded squares in the low-resolution row are unlabelled; they read as masked positions and a lower unit rate. The waveform hex is read off the bitmap.
